sql:
SELECT p.Policy_Identifier,
       apr.Party_Identifier AS Policy_Holder_Identifier
FROM Policy p
JOIN Agreement_Party_Role apr
  ON apr.Agreement_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
WHERE apr.Party_Role_Code = 'PH'
   OR UPPER(apr.Party_Role_Code) LIKE '%HOLDER%'
ORDER BY p.Policy_Identifier

SELECT p.Policy_Number,
       COUNT(DISTINCT cc.Claim_Identifier) AS Claim_Count
FROM Claim_Coverage cc
JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail pcd
  ON pcd.Effective_Date = cc.Effective_Date
 AND pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
JOIN Policy p
  ON p.Policy_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Identifier
GROUP BY p.Policy_Number
ORDER BY Claim_Count DESC

SELECT
    cat.Catastrophe_Identifier,
    cat.Catastrophe_Name,
    p.Policy_Number,
    SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS Total_Loss
FROM Claim_Amount ca
JOIN Claim c
    ON c.Claim_Identifier = ca.Claim_Identifier
JOIN Catastrophe cat
    ON cat.Catastrophe_Identifier = c.Catastrophe_Identifier
JOIN Claim_Coverage cc
    ON cc.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail pcd
    ON pcd.Effective_Date = cc.Effective_Date
   AND pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
JOIN Policy p
    ON p.Policy_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Identifier
WHERE ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier IN (
    SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM Loss_Payment
    UNION
    SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM Loss_Reserve
    UNION
    SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM Expense_Payment
    UNION
    SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM Expense_Reserve
)
GROUP BY cat.Catastrophe_Identifier, cat.Catastrophe_Name, p.Policy_Number

SELECT p.Policy_Number,
       AVG(julianday(c.Claim_Close_Date) - julianday(c.Claim_Open_Date)) AS avg_days_to_settle
FROM Claim c
JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT cc.Claim_Identifier, pcd.Policy_Identifier
    FROM Claim_Coverage cc
    JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail pcd
      ON pcd.Effective_Date = cc.Effective_Date
     AND pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
) cp ON cp.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
JOIN Policy p ON p.Policy_Identifier = cp.Policy_Identifier
WHERE c.Claim_Open_Date IS NOT NULL
  AND c.Claim_Close_Date IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY p.Policy_Number

WITH loss_amt AS (
    SELECT ca.Claim_Identifier, ca.Claim_Amount
    FROM Claim_Amount ca
    WHERE ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier IN (
        SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM Loss_Payment
        UNION
        SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM Loss_Reserve
        UNION
        SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM Expense_Payment
        UNION
        SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM Expense_Reserve
    )
),
claim_policy AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT cc.Claim_Identifier, pcd.Policy_Identifier
    FROM Claim_Coverage cc
    JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail pcd
      ON pcd.Effective_Date = cc.Effective_Date
     AND pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
)
SELECT p.Policy_Number,
       COUNT(DISTINCT cp.Claim_Identifier) AS Number_Of_Claims,
       AVG(la.Claim_Amount) AS Average_Loss
FROM Policy p
JOIN claim_policy cp ON cp.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
JOIN loss_amt la ON la.Claim_Identifier = cp.Claim_Identifier
GROUP BY p.Policy_Number

SELECT DISTINCT apr.Party_Identifier AS Policy_Holder_Identifier,
       c.Claim_Identifier,
       c.Company_Claim_Number,
       cat.Catastrophe_Identifier,
       cat.Catastrophe_Name,
       cat.Catastrophe_Type_Code
FROM Agreement_Party_Role apr
JOIN Policy p ON p.Policy_Identifier = apr.Agreement_Identifier
JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail pcd ON pcd.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
JOIN Claim_Coverage cc ON cc.Effective_Date = pcd.Effective_Date
                      AND cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
JOIN Claim c ON c.Claim_Identifier = cc.Claim_Identifier
JOIN Catastrophe cat ON cat.Catastrophe_Identifier = c.Catastrophe_Identifier
WHERE LOWER(apr.Party_Role_Code) LIKE '%policy%holder%'
   OR LOWER(apr.Party_Role_Code) LIKE '%policyholder%'

SELECT c.Company_Claim_Number, SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS Loss_Reserve_Amount
FROM Claim c
JOIN Claim_Amount ca ON ca.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
JOIN Loss_Reserve lr ON lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
GROUP BY c.Company_Claim_Number

SELECT apr.Party_Identifier AS Agent_Id,
       p.Policy_Number,
       c.Company_Claim_Number AS Claim_Number,
       SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS Expense_Reserve_Amount
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT cc.Claim_Identifier, pcd.Policy_Identifier
    FROM Claim_Coverage cc
    JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail pcd
      ON pcd.Effective_Date = cc.Effective_Date
     AND pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
) cp
JOIN Claim c ON c.Claim_Identifier = cp.Claim_Identifier
JOIN Policy p ON p.Policy_Identifier = cp.Policy_Identifier
JOIN Agreement_Party_Role apr
  ON apr.Agreement_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
 AND apr.Party_Role_Code LIKE '%agent%'
JOIN Claim_Amount ca ON ca.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
JOIN Expense_Reserve er ON er.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
GROUP BY apr.Party_Identifier, p.Policy_Number, c.Company_Claim_Number
ORDER BY apr.Party_Identifier, p.Policy_Number, c.Company_Claim_Number

SELECT pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier, pa.Policy_Identifier, pa.Effective_Date, pa.Earning_Begin_Date, pa.Earning_End_Date, pa.Policy_Amount
FROM Premium p
JOIN Policy_Amount pa ON pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier = p.Policy_Amount_Identifier

SELECT apr.Party_Identifier AS Agent_Id,
       p.Policy_Number,
       c.Company_Claim_Number AS Claim_Number,
       SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS Loss_Reserve_Amount
FROM Agreement_Party_Role apr
JOIN Policy p ON p.Policy_Identifier = apr.Agreement_Identifier
JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail pcd ON pcd.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
JOIN Claim_Coverage cc ON cc.Effective_Date = pcd.Effective_Date
                      AND cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
JOIN Claim c ON c.Claim_Identifier = cc.Claim_Identifier
JOIN Claim_Amount ca ON ca.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
JOIN Loss_Reserve lr ON lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
WHERE UPPER(apr.Party_Role_Code) LIKE 'AG%'
GROUP BY apr.Party_Identifier, p.Policy_Number, c.Company_Claim_Number
ORDER BY apr.Party_Identifier, p.Policy_Number, c.Company_Claim_Number

SELECT Company_Claim_Number
FROM Claim
WHERE Claim_Close_Date >= '2019-01-01'
  AND Claim_Close_Date < '2020-01-01'

SELECT
    c.Company_Claim_Number AS claim_number,
    cat.Catastrophe_Name AS catastrophe,
    cp.Policy_Number AS policy_number,
    SUM(a.total_loss) AS total_loss
FROM Claim c
JOIN (
    SELECT ca.Claim_Identifier, SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS total_loss
    FROM Claim_Amount ca
    WHERE ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier IN (
        SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM Loss_Payment
        UNION ALL
        SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM Loss_Reserve
        UNION ALL
        SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM Expense_Payment
        UNION ALL
        SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM Expense_Reserve
    )
    GROUP BY ca.Claim_Identifier
) a ON a.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Catastrophe cat ON cat.Catastrophe_Identifier = c.Catastrophe_Identifier
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT cc.Claim_Identifier, p.Policy_Number
    FROM Claim_Coverage cc
    JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail pcd
        ON pcd.Effective_Date = cc.Effective_Date
       AND pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
    JOIN Policy p ON p.Policy_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Identifier
) cp ON cp.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
GROUP BY c.Company_Claim_Number, cat.Catastrophe_Name, cp.Policy_Number

SELECT apr.Party_Identifier AS Agent_Id,
       COUNT(DISTINCT p.Policy_Identifier) AS Policy_Count
FROM Agreement_Party_Role apr
JOIN Policy p ON p.Policy_Identifier = apr.Agreement_Identifier
WHERE UPPER(apr.Party_Role_Code) LIKE 'AG%'
GROUP BY apr.Party_Identifier

SELECT SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT pa.Policy_Identifier) AS average_policy_size
FROM Premium p
JOIN Policy_Amount pa ON pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier = p.Policy_Amount_Identifier

SELECT p.Policy_Number,
       pcd.Effective_Date AS Coverage_Effective_Date,
       pcd.Expiration_Date AS Coverage_Expiration_Date,
       SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS Premium_Amount
FROM Premium pr
JOIN Policy_Amount pa
  ON pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier
JOIN Policy p
  ON p.Policy_Identifier = pa.Policy_Identifier
JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail pcd
  ON pcd.Effective_Date = pa.Effective_Date
 AND pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = pa.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
GROUP BY p.Policy_Number, pcd.Effective_Date, pcd.Expiration_Date

WITH policy_premium AS (
    SELECT pa.Policy_Identifier,
           SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS total_premium
    FROM Policy_Amount pa
    JOIN Premium pr ON pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier
    GROUP BY pa.Policy_Identifier
),
claim_policy AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT cc.Claim_Identifier, pcd.Policy_Identifier
    FROM Claim_Coverage cc
    JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail pcd
      ON pcd.Effective_Date = cc.Effective_Date
     AND pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
),
policy_loss AS (
    SELECT cp.Policy_Identifier,
           SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS total_loss
    FROM claim_policy cp
    JOIN Claim_Amount ca ON ca.Claim_Identifier = cp.Claim_Identifier
    JOIN Loss_Payment lp ON lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    GROUP BY cp.Policy_Identifier
),
policy_agent AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT apr.Agreement_Identifier AS Policy_Identifier,
           apr.Party_Identifier AS Agent_Id
    FROM Agreement_Party_Role apr
    WHERE UPPER(apr.Party_Role_Code) LIKE 'AG%'
)
SELECT p.Policy_Number,
       a.Agent_Id,
       COALESCE(l.total_loss, 0) AS total_loss,
       pp.total_premium,
       COALESCE(l.total_loss, 0) * 1.0 / NULLIF(pp.total_premium, 0) AS loss_ratio
FROM Policy p
JOIN policy_agent a ON a.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
JOIN policy_premium pp ON pp.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN policy_loss l ON l.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
ORDER BY p.Policy_Number, a.Agent_Id

SELECT c.Company_Claim_Number,
       SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS Total_Loss
FROM Claim c
JOIN Claim_Amount ca ON ca.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
WHERE ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier IN (
    SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM Loss_Payment
    UNION ALL
    SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM Loss_Reserve
    UNION ALL
    SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM Expense_Payment
    UNION ALL
    SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM Expense_Reserve
)
GROUP BY c.Company_Claim_Number

WITH amt AS (
    SELECT ca.Claim_Identifier, ca.Claim_Amount
    FROM Claim_Amount ca
    WHERE ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier IN (
        SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM Loss_Payment
        UNION
        SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM Loss_Reserve
        UNION
        SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM Expense_Payment
        UNION
        SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM Expense_Reserve
    )
),
cp AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT cc.Claim_Identifier, pcd.Policy_Identifier
    FROM Claim_Coverage cc
    JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail pcd
      ON pcd.Effective_Date = cc.Effective_Date
     AND pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
),
ag AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT Agreement_Identifier, Party_Identifier
    FROM Agreement_Party_Role
    WHERE Party_Role_Code = 'AG'
)
SELECT ag.Party_Identifier AS Agent_Identifier,
       cp.Policy_Identifier,
       SUM(amt.Claim_Amount) AS Total_Loss
FROM ag
JOIN cp ON cp.Policy_Identifier = ag.Agreement_Identifier
JOIN amt ON amt.Claim_Identifier = cp.Claim_Identifier
GROUP BY ag.Party_Identifier, cp.Policy_Identifier

SELECT DISTINCT p.Policy_Number, c.Company_Claim_Number
FROM Claim c
JOIN Claim_Coverage cc ON cc.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail pcd ON pcd.Effective_Date = cc.Effective_Date
    AND pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
JOIN Policy p ON p.Policy_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Identifier
ORDER BY p.Policy_Number, c.Company_Claim_Number

SELECT p.Policy_Number, apr.Party_Identifier AS Agent_Id
FROM Policy AS p
JOIN Agreement_Party_Role AS apr
  ON apr.Agreement_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
WHERE apr.Party_Role_Code LIKE '%agent%'
ORDER BY p.Policy_Number, apr.Party_Identifier

SELECT p.Policy_Number,
       SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS Total_Premium
FROM Premium pr
JOIN Policy_Amount pa ON pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier
JOIN Policy p ON p.Policy_Identifier = pa.Policy_Identifier
GROUP BY p.Policy_Number

SELECT c.Company_Claim_Number, SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS Expense_Payment_Amount
FROM Expense_Payment ep
JOIN Claim_Amount ca ON ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier
JOIN Claim c ON c.Claim_Identifier = ca.Claim_Identifier
GROUP BY c.Company_Claim_Number

WITH claim_policy AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT cc.Claim_Identifier, pcd.Policy_Identifier
    FROM Claim_Coverage cc
    JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail pcd
      ON pcd.Effective_Date = cc.Effective_Date
     AND pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
),
claim_loss AS (
    SELECT ca.Claim_Identifier, SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS total_loss
    FROM Claim_Amount ca
    WHERE ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier IN (
        SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM Loss_Payment
        UNION
        SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM Loss_Reserve
        UNION
        SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM Expense_Payment
        UNION
        SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM Expense_Reserve
    )
    GROUP BY ca.Claim_Identifier
),
policy_premium AS (
    SELECT pa.Policy_Identifier, SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS premium
    FROM Policy_Amount pa
    JOIN Premium pr ON pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier
    GROUP BY pa.Policy_Identifier
)
SELECT
    po.Policy_Number,
    pp.premium AS Premium,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cp.Claim_Identifier) AS Number_of_Claims,
    SUM(COALESCE(cl.total_loss, 0)) AS Total_Loss,
    SUM(COALESCE(cl.total_loss, 0)) * 1.0 / NULLIF(pp.premium, 0) AS Loss_Ratio
FROM Policy po
JOIN policy_premium pp ON pp.Policy_Identifier = po.Policy_Identifier
JOIN claim_policy cp ON cp.Policy_Identifier = po.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN claim_loss cl ON cl.Claim_Identifier = cp.Claim_Identifier
GROUP BY po.Policy_Identifier, po.Policy_Number, pp.premium

WITH claim_amt AS (
    SELECT ca.Claim_Identifier,
           SUM(CASE WHEN lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) AS Loss_Payment_Amount,
           SUM(CASE WHEN lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) AS Loss_Reserve_Amount,
           SUM(CASE WHEN ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) AS Expense_Payment_Amount,
           SUM(CASE WHEN er.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) AS Expense_Reserve_Amount
    FROM Claim_Amount ca
    LEFT JOIN Loss_Payment lp ON lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN Loss_Reserve lr ON lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN Expense_Payment ep ON ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN Expense_Reserve er ON er.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    GROUP BY ca.Claim_Identifier
),
claim_policy AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT cc.Claim_Identifier, pcd.Policy_Identifier
    FROM Claim_Coverage cc
    JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail pcd
      ON pcd.Effective_Date = cc.Effective_Date
     AND pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
),
prem AS (
    SELECT pa.Policy_Identifier, SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS Premium_Amount
    FROM Policy_Amount pa
    JOIN Premium pr ON pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier
    GROUP BY pa.Policy_Identifier
),
holder AS (
    SELECT Agreement_Identifier, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT Party_Identifier) AS Policy_Holder
    FROM Agreement_Party_Role
    WHERE Party_Role_Code LIKE '%holder%'
    GROUP BY Agreement_Identifier
),
agent AS (
    SELECT Agreement_Identifier, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT Party_Identifier) AS Agent
    FROM Agreement_Party_Role
    WHERE Party_Role_Code LIKE '%agent%'
    GROUP BY Agreement_Identifier
)
SELECT c.Company_Claim_Number,
       c.Company_Subclaim_Number,
       p.Policy_Number,
       h.Policy_Holder,
       COALESCE(ca.Loss_Payment_Amount, 0) AS Loss_Payment_Amount,
       COALESCE(ca.Loss_Reserve_Amount, 0) AS Loss_Reserve_Amount,
       COALESCE(ca.Expense_Payment_Amount, 0) AS Expense_Payment_Amount,
       COALESCE(ca.Expense_Reserve_Amount, 0) AS Expense_Reserve_Amount,
       pm.Premium_Amount,
       cat.Catastrophe_Name,
       a.Agent
FROM Claim c
LEFT JOIN claim_amt ca ON ca.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN claim_policy cp ON cp.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Policy p ON p.Policy_Identifier = cp.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN prem pm ON pm.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN holder h ON h.Agreement_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN agent a ON a.Agreement_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Catastrophe cat ON cat.Catastrophe_Identifier = c.Catastrophe_Identifier
ORDER BY c.Company_Claim_Number, c.Company_Subclaim_Number

SELECT c.Company_Claim_Number,
       SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS Expense_Reserve_Amount
FROM Expense_Reserve er
JOIN Claim_Amount ca ON ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier = er.Claim_Amount_Identifier
JOIN Claim c ON c.Claim_Identifier = ca.Claim_Identifier
GROUP BY c.Claim_Identifier, c.Company_Claim_Number
ORDER BY c.Company_Claim_Number

SELECT p.Policy_Number,
       AVG(ca.Claim_Amount) AS Average_Loss
FROM Claim_Amount ca
JOIN Claim_Coverage cc
  ON cc.Claim_Identifier = ca.Claim_Identifier
JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail pcd
  ON pcd.Effective_Date = cc.Effective_Date
 AND pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
JOIN Policy p
  ON p.Policy_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Identifier
WHERE ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier IN (
    SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM Loss_Payment
    UNION ALL
    SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM Loss_Reserve
    UNION ALL
    SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM Expense_Payment
    UNION ALL
    SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM Expense_Reserve
)
GROUP BY p.Policy_Number

SELECT Company_Claim_Number, Claim_Open_Date, Claim_Close_Date
FROM Claim

SELECT c.Company_Claim_Number,
       SUM(CASE WHEN lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) AS Loss_Payment_Amount,
       SUM(CASE WHEN lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) AS Loss_Reserve_Amount,
       SUM(CASE WHEN ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) AS Expense_Payment_Amount,
       SUM(CASE WHEN er.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) AS Expense_Reserve_Amount
FROM Claim c
JOIN Claim_Amount ca ON ca.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Loss_Payment lp ON lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Loss_Reserve lr ON lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Expense_Payment ep ON ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Expense_Reserve er ON er.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
GROUP BY c.Company_Claim_Number

WITH claim_amt AS (
    SELECT ca.Claim_Identifier,
           SUM(CASE WHEN lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) AS Loss_Payment_Amount,
           SUM(CASE WHEN lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) AS Loss_Reserve_Amount,
           SUM(CASE WHEN ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) AS Expense_Payment_Amount,
           SUM(CASE WHEN er.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) AS Expense_Reserve_Amount
    FROM Claim_Amount ca
    LEFT JOIN Loss_Payment lp ON lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN Loss_Reserve lr ON lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN Expense_Payment ep ON ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN Expense_Reserve er ON er.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    GROUP BY ca.Claim_Identifier
),
claim_policy AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT cc.Claim_Identifier, pcd.Policy_Identifier
    FROM Claim_Coverage cc
    JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail pcd
      ON pcd.Effective_Date = cc.Effective_Date
     AND pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
),
policy_premium AS (
    SELECT pa.Policy_Identifier, SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS Premium_Amount
    FROM Policy_Amount pa
    JOIN Premium pr ON pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier
    GROUP BY pa.Policy_Identifier
)
SELECT c.Company_Claim_Number,
       p.Policy_Number,
       apr.Party_Identifier AS Policy_Holder_Party_Identifier,
       apr.Party_Role_Code,
       cam.Loss_Payment_Amount,
       cam.Loss_Reserve_Amount,
       cam.Expense_Payment_Amount,
       cam.Expense_Reserve_Amount,
       pp.Premium_Amount
FROM Claim c
LEFT JOIN claim_amt cam ON cam.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN claim_policy cp ON cp.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Policy p ON p.Policy_Identifier = cp.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Agreement_Party_Role apr ON apr.Agreement_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN policy_premium pp ON pp.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
ORDER BY c.Company_Claim_Number, p.Policy_Number
SELECT COUNT(*) AS claim_count FROM Claim

SELECT SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS Total_Premium
FROM Premium AS p
JOIN Policy_Amount AS pa
  ON pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier = p.Policy_Amount_Identifier

SELECT c.Company_Claim_Number,
       SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS Total_Loss_Amount
FROM Claim c
JOIN Claim_Amount ca ON ca.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
WHERE ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier IN (
    SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM Loss_Payment
    UNION
    SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM Loss_Reserve
)
GROUP BY c.Company_Claim_Number

SELECT p.Policy_Number, SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS Total_Premium
FROM Policy p
JOIN Policy_Amount pa ON pa.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
JOIN Premium pr ON pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier
GROUP BY p.Policy_Number

SELECT Policy_Number, Effective_Date, Expiration_Date
FROM Policy

SELECT apr.Party_Identifier AS Agent_Id,
       p.Policy_Number,
       c.Company_Claim_Number AS Claim_Number,
       SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS Expense_Payment_Amount
FROM Agreement_Party_Role apr
JOIN Policy p ON p.Policy_Identifier = apr.Agreement_Identifier
JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail pcd ON pcd.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
JOIN Claim_Coverage cc ON cc.Effective_Date = pcd.Effective_Date
                      AND cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
JOIN Claim c ON c.Claim_Identifier = cc.Claim_Identifier
JOIN Claim_Amount ca ON ca.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
JOIN Expense_Payment ep ON ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
WHERE apr.Party_Role_Code LIKE 'ag%'
GROUP BY apr.Party_Identifier, p.Policy_Number, c.Company_Claim_Number
ORDER BY apr.Party_Identifier, p.Policy_Number, c.Company_Claim_Number

WITH claim_amt AS (
    SELECT
        ca.Claim_Identifier,
        SUM(CASE WHEN lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) AS Loss_Payment_Amount,
        SUM(CASE WHEN lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) AS Loss_Reserve_Amount,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) AS Expense_Payment_Amount,
        SUM(CASE WHEN er.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) AS Expense_Reserve_Amount
    FROM Claim_Amount ca
    LEFT JOIN Loss_Payment lp ON lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN Loss_Reserve lr ON lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN Expense_Payment ep ON ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN Expense_Reserve er ON er.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    GROUP BY ca.Claim_Identifier
),
claim_policy AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT cc.Claim_Identifier, pcd.Policy_Identifier
    FROM Claim_Coverage cc
    JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail pcd
      ON pcd.Effective_Date = cc.Effective_Date
     AND pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
),
prem AS (
    SELECT pa.Policy_Identifier, SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS Premium_Amount
    FROM Policy_Amount pa
    JOIN Premium pr ON pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier
    GROUP BY pa.Policy_Identifier
)
SELECT
    c.Company_Claim_Number,
    p.Policy_Number,
    holder.Party_Identifier AS Policy_Holder_Party_Identifier,
    prem.Premium_Amount,
    agent.Party_Identifier AS Agent_Party_Identifier,
    COALESCE(amt.Loss_Payment_Amount, 0) AS Loss_Payment_Amount,
    COALESCE(amt.Loss_Reserve_Amount, 0) AS Loss_Reserve_Amount,
    COALESCE(amt.Expense_Payment_Amount, 0) AS Expense_Payment_Amount,

LEFT JOIN Policy p ON p.Policy_Identifier = cp.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN prem ON prem.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Agreement_Party_Role holder
  ON holder.Agreement_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
 AND holder.Party_Role_Code LIKE '%holder%'

SELECT c.Company_Claim_Number,

SELECT DISTINCT p.Policy_Number, c.Company_Claim_Number

WITH ca AS (

WITH prem AS (

    GROUP BY pa.Policy_Identifier
),
claim_policy AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT cc.Claim_Identifier, pcd.Policy_Identifier
    FROM Claim_Coverage cc
    JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail pcd

),
loss AS (

      ON ca.Claim_Identifier = cp.Claim_Identifier
    JOIN Loss_Payment lp
      ON lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    GROUP BY cp.Policy_Identifier
),
agent AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT Agreement_Identifier, Party_Identifier
    FROM Agreement_Party_Role
    WHERE UPPER(Party_Role_Code) LIKE 'AG%'

       COALESCE(l.Total_Loss_Paid, 0) AS Total_Loss_Paid,
       pr.Total_Premium,
       COALESCE(l.Total_Loss_Paid, 0) * 1.0 / NULLIF(pr.Total_Premium, 0) AS Loss_Ratio

  ON a.Agreement_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier

  ON pr.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN loss l
  ON l.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier

SELECT p.Policy_Number, apr.Party_Identifier AS Agent_Id
FROM Policy p
JOIN Agreement_Party_Role apr
  ON apr.Agreement_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
WHERE apr.Party_Role_Code LIKE 'ag%'

SELECT c.Company_Claim_Number, SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS Expense_Payment_Amount
FROM Claim c
JOIN Claim_Amount ca ON ca.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
JOIN Expense_Payment ep ON ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
GROUP BY c.Company_Claim_Number

WITH claim_policy AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT cc.Claim_Identifier, pcd.Policy_Identifier
    FROM Claim_Coverage cc
    JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail pcd
      ON pcd.Effective_Date = cc.Effective_Date
     AND pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
),
amt AS (
    SELECT ca.Claim_Identifier,
           SUM(CASE WHEN lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount END) AS Loss_Payment_Amount,
           SUM(CASE WHEN lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount END) AS Loss_Reserve_Amount,
           SUM(CASE WHEN ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount END) AS Expense_Payment_Amount,
           SUM(CASE WHEN er.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount END) AS Expense_Reserve_Amount
    FROM Claim_Amount ca
    LEFT JOIN Loss_Payment lp ON lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN Loss_Reserve lr ON lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN Expense_Payment ep ON ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN Expense_Reserve er ON er.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    GROUP BY ca.Claim_Identifier
),
prem AS (
    SELECT pa.Policy_Identifier, SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS Premium_Amount
    FROM Policy_Amount pa
    JOIN Premium pr ON pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier
    GROUP BY pa.Policy_Identifier
),
holder AS (
    SELECT Agreement_Identifier, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT Party_Identifier) AS Policy_Holder
    FROM Agreement_Party_Role
    WHERE LOWER(Party_Role_Code) LIKE '%holder%'

),
agent AS (
    SELECT Agreement_Identifier, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT Party_Identifier) AS Agent
    FROM Agreement_Party_Role
    WHERE LOWER(Party_Role_Code) LIKE '%agent%'
    GROUP BY Agreement_Identifier
)
SELECT c.Company_Claim_Number,

LEFT JOIN claim_policy cp ON cp.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier

LEFT JOIN prem pr ON pr.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Catastrophe cat ON cat.Catastrophe_Identifier = c.Catastrophe_Identifier
LEFT JOIN agent ag ON ag.Agreement_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
ORDER BY c.Company_Claim_Number, c.Company_Subclaim_Number

SELECT p.Policy_Number, SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS Total_Premium
FROM Premium pr
JOIN Policy_Amount pa ON pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier
JOIN Policy p ON p.Policy_Identifier = pa.Policy_Identifier

WITH claim_policy AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT cc.Claim_Identifier, pcd.Policy_Identifier

    JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail pcd

claim_loss AS (

    WHERE ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier IN (
        SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM Loss_Payment
        UNION
        SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM Loss_Reserve
        UNION
        SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM Expense_Payment
        UNION
        SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM Expense_Reserve
    )
    GROUP BY ca.Claim_Identifier
),
policy_loss AS (
    SELECT cp.Policy_Identifier,
           COUNT(DISTINCT cp.Claim_Identifier) AS number_of_claims,

),
policy_premium AS (

    GROUP BY pa.Policy_Identifier
)
SELECT p.Policy_Number,

       pp.premium
FROM Policy p
JOIN policy_loss pl ON pl.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
JOIN policy_premium pp ON pp.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
ORDER BY p.Policy_Number

SELECT c.Company_Claim_Number, SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS Expense_Reserve_Amount
FROM Expense_Reserve er
JOIN Claim_Amount ca ON er.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
JOIN Claim c ON ca.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier

SELECT p.Policy_Number,

JOIN Claim_Coverage cc ON cc.Claim_Identifier = ca.Claim_Identifier
JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail pcd
  ON pcd.Effective_Date = cc.Effective_Date
 AND pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier

    SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM Loss_Payment

    UNION ALL
    SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM Expense_Payment
    UNION ALL
    SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM Expense_Reserve
)
GROUP BY p.Policy_Number

SELECT
    c.Company_Claim_Number,
    SUM(CASE WHEN lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) AS Loss_Payment_Amount,

    JOIN Loss_Reserve lr ON lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier

WITH premium_by_policy AS (

    GROUP BY pa.Policy_Identifier
),
claim_policy AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT cc.Claim_Identifier, pcd.Policy_Identifier

    JOIN Loss_Payment lp ON lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier

),
policy_agent AS (

            ELSE COALESCE(l.total_loss, 0) * 1.0 / pr.total_premium
       END AS loss_ratio
FROM Policy p
JOIN policy_agent pa ON pa.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier

claim_policy AS (

WITH claim_policy AS (

       OR ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier IN (SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM Expense_Reserve)
    GROUP BY ca.Claim_Identifier
),
policy_premium AS (

    JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail pcd
      ON pa.Effective_Date = pcd.Effective_Date
     AND pa.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
    GROUP BY pcd.Policy_Identifier
)

    CASE WHEN pp.premium IS NULL OR pp.premium = 0 THEN NULL
         ELSE COALESCE(SUM(cl.loss_amount), 0) * 1.0 / pp.premium
    END AS Loss_Ratio
FROM Policy p
JOIN claim_policy cp ON cp.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier

SELECT

    a.Expense_Reserve_Amount
FROM Claim c
LEFT JOIN claim_amt a ON a.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN claim_policy cp ON cp.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Policy p ON p.Policy_Identifier = cp.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Agreement_Party_Role apr
  ON apr.Agreement_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
 AND apr.Party_Role_Code = 'PH'
LEFT JOIN policy_premium pp ON pp.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
ORDER BY c.Company_Claim_Number, p.Policy_Number

SELECT apr.Party_Identifier AS Policy_Holder,
       SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS Total_Premium
FROM Agreement_Party_Role apr
JOIN Policy p ON p.Policy_Identifier = apr.Agreement_Identifier
JOIN Policy_Amount pa ON pa.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
JOIN Premium pr ON pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier
WHERE apr.Party_Role_Code = 'PH'
GROUP BY apr.Party_Identifier
ORDER BY Total_Premium DESC

WITH agent_policy_claim AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        apr.Party_Identifier AS agent_id,
        p.Policy_Number AS policy_number,
        c.Claim_Identifier AS claim_identifier,
        c.Company_Claim_Number AS claim_number
    FROM Claim c
    JOIN Claim_Coverage cc
        ON cc.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
    JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail pcd
        ON pcd.Effective_Date = cc.Effective_Date
       AND pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
    JOIN Policy p
        ON p.Policy_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Identifier
    JOIN Agreement_Party_Role apr
        ON apr.Agreement_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
       AND apr.Party_Role_Code = 'AG'
)
SELECT
    apc.agent_id,
    apc.policy_number,
    apc.claim_number,
    SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS expense_payment_amount
FROM agent_policy_claim apc
JOIN Claim_Amount ca
    ON ca.Claim_Identifier = apc.claim_identifier
JOIN Expense_Payment ep
    ON ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
GROUP BY apc.agent_id, apc.policy_number, apc.claim_number
ORDER BY apc.agent_id, apc.policy_number, apc.claim_number

SELECT Policy_Number, Effective_Date, Expiration_Date
FROM Policy
SELECT COUNT(*) AS policy_count FROM Policy

SELECT Party_Identifier AS policy_holder_id,
       COUNT(DISTINCT Agreement_Identifier) AS policy_count
FROM Agreement_Party_Role
JOIN Policy ON Agreement_Party_Role.Agreement_Identifier = Policy.Policy_Identifier
WHERE Party_Role_Code = 'PH'
GROUP BY Party_Identifier

SELECT p.Policy_Number,
       SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS Total_Premium
FROM Premium pr
JOIN Policy_Amount pa ON pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier
JOIN Policy p ON p.Policy_Identifier = pa.Policy_Identifier
GROUP BY p.Policy_Number
ORDER BY p.Policy_Number

WITH amt AS (
    SELECT ca.Claim_Identifier,
           SUM(CASE WHEN lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount END) AS Loss_Payment_Amount,
           SUM(CASE WHEN lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount END) AS Loss_Reserve_Amount,
           SUM(CASE WHEN ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount END) AS Expense_Payment_Amount,
           SUM(CASE WHEN er.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount END) AS Expense_Reserve_Amount
    FROM Claim_Amount ca
    LEFT JOIN Loss_Payment lp ON lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN Loss_Reserve lr ON lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN Expense_Payment ep ON ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN Expense_Reserve er ON er.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    GROUP BY ca.Claim_Identifier
),
prem AS (
    SELECT pa.Effective_Date,
           pa.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier,
           SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS Premium_Amount
    FROM Policy_Amount pa
    JOIN Premium pr ON pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier
    GROUP BY pa.Effective_Date, pa.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
)
SELECT c.Company_Claim_Number AS Claim_Number,
       p.Policy_Number,
       ph.Party_Identifier AS Policy_Holder,
       SUM(prem.Premium_Amount) AS Premium_Amount,
       ag.Party_Identifier AS Agent,
       MAX(amt.Loss_Payment_Amount) AS Loss_Payment_Amount,
       MAX(amt.Loss_Reserve_Amount) AS Loss_Reserve_Amount,
       MAX(amt.Expense_Payment_Amount) AS Expense_Payment_Amount,
       MAX(amt.Expense_Reserve_Amount) AS Expense_Reserve_Amount
FROM Claim c
LEFT JOIN amt ON amt.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
JOIN Claim_Coverage cc ON cc.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail pcd
     ON pcd.Effective_Date = cc.Effective_Date
    AND pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
JOIN Policy p ON p.Policy_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN prem
     ON prem.Effective_Date = pcd.Effective_Date
    AND prem.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Agreement_Party_Role ph
     ON ph.Agreement_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
    AND ph.Party_Role_Code = 'PH'
LEFT JOIN Agreement_Party_Role ag
     ON ag.Agreement_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
    AND ag.Party_Role_Code = 'AG'
GROUP BY c.Claim_Identifier, c.Company_Claim_Number, p.Policy_Identifier, p.Policy_Number,
         ph.Party_Identifier, ag.Party_Identifier

SELECT p.Policy_Number,
       SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS Total_Loss
FROM Policy p
JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT pcd.Policy_Identifier, cc.Claim_Identifier
    FROM Claim_Coverage cc
    JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail pcd
      ON cc.Effective_Date = pcd.Effective_Date
     AND cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
) pc ON pc.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
JOIN Claim_Amount ca ON ca.Claim_Identifier = pc.Claim_Identifier
WHERE ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier IN (
    SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM Loss_Payment
    UNION
    SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM Loss_Reserve
    UNION
    SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM Expense_Payment
    UNION
    SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM Expense_Reserve
)
GROUP BY p.Policy_Number

SELECT ag.Party_Identifier AS agent_id,
       p.Policy_Number AS policy_number,
       c.Company_Claim_Number AS claim_number,
       SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS loss_payment_amount
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT Agreement_Identifier, Party_Identifier
      FROM Agreement_Party_Role
      WHERE Party_Role_Code = 'AG') ag
JOIN Policy p ON p.Policy_Identifier = ag.Agreement_Identifier
JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT cc.Claim_Identifier, pcd.Policy_Identifier

      JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail pcd
        ON pcd.Effective_Date = cc.Effective_Date
       AND pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier) cp
  ON cp.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
JOIN Claim c ON c.Claim_Identifier = cp.Claim_Identifier
JOIN Claim_Amount ca ON ca.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
JOIN Loss_Payment lp ON lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
GROUP BY ag.Party_Identifier, p.Policy_Number, c.Company_Claim_Number
ORDER BY ag.Party_Identifier, p.Policy_Number, c.Company_Claim_Number

SELECT DISTINCT
    apr.Party_Identifier AS Agent_Identifier,
    p.Policy_Identifier,
    p.Policy_Number,
    c.Claim_Identifier,

    cat.Catastrophe_Name
FROM Agreement_Party_Role apr
JOIN Policy p

    ON pcd.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier

JOIN Claim c

JOIN Catastrophe cat

SELECT p.Policy_Number, pa.Policy_Amount AS Premium_Amount
FROM Premium pr
JOIN Policy_Amount pa ON pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier
JOIN Policy p ON pa.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
ORDER BY p.Policy_Number

SELECT c.Company_Claim_Number, ca.Claim_Amount AS Loss_Payment_Amount
FROM Claim c
JOIN Claim_Amount ca ON ca.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
JOIN Loss_Payment lp ON lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
ORDER BY c.Company_Claim_Number

WITH loss_by_claim AS (
    SELECT ca.Claim_Identifier,
           SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS Total_Loss
    FROM Claim_Amount ca
    WHERE ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier IN (SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM Loss_Payment)
       OR ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier IN (SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM Loss_Reserve)
       OR ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier IN (SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM Expense_Payment)
       OR ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier IN (SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM Expense_Reserve)
    GROUP BY ca.Claim_Identifier
),
claim_policy AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT cc.Claim_Identifier, pcd.Policy_Identifier
    FROM Claim_Coverage cc
    JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail pcd
      ON pcd.Effective_Date = cc.Effective_Date
     AND pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
),
premium_by_policy AS (
    SELECT pcd.Policy_Identifier,
           SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS Premium_Amount
    FROM Policy_Amount pa
    JOIN Premium pr ON pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier
    JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail pcd
      ON pcd.Effective_Date = pa.Effective_Date
     AND pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = pa.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
    GROUP BY pcd.Policy_Identifier
)
SELECT c.Company_Claim_Number AS Claim_Number,
       l.Total_Loss,
       p.Policy_Number,
       apr.Party_Identifier AS Policy_Holder,
       pp.Premium_Amount
FROM Claim c
JOIN loss_by_claim l ON l.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN claim_policy cp ON cp.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Policy p ON p.Policy_Identifier = cp.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Agreement_Party_Role apr
       ON apr.Agreement_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
      AND apr.Party_Role_Code = 'PH'
LEFT JOIN premium_by_policy pp ON pp.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
ORDER BY c.Company_Claim_Number

SELECT p.Policy_Number, COUNT(DISTINCT cc.Claim_Identifier) AS claim_count
FROM Policy p
JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail pcd ON pcd.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
JOIN Claim_Coverage cc ON cc.Effective_Date = pcd.Effective_Date
  AND cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
GROUP BY p.Policy_Identifier, p.Policy_Number

SELECT c.Catastrophe_Name,
       p.Policy_Number,
       SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS Total_Loss
FROM Claim cl
JOIN Catastrophe c
  ON c.Catastrophe_Identifier = cl.Catastrophe_Identifier
JOIN (
      SELECT DISTINCT cc.Claim_Identifier, pcd.Policy_Identifier
      FROM Claim_Coverage cc
      JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail pcd
        ON pcd.Effective_Date = cc.Effective_Date
       AND pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
     ) cp
  ON cp.Claim_Identifier = cl.Claim_Identifier
JOIN Policy p
  ON p.Policy_Identifier = cp.Policy_Identifier
JOIN Claim_Amount ca
  ON ca.Claim_Identifier = cl.Claim_Identifier
WHERE ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier IN (
      SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM Loss_Payment
      UNION
      SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM Loss_Reserve
      UNION
      SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM Expense_Payment
      UNION
      SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM Expense_Reserve
)
GROUP BY c.Catastrophe_Identifier, c.Catastrophe_Name, p.Policy_Identifier, p.Policy_Number

WITH claim_policy AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT cc.Claim_Identifier, pcd.Policy_Identifier
    FROM Claim_Coverage cc
    JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail pcd
      ON cc.Effective_Date = pcd.Effective_Date
     AND cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
),
claim_loss AS (
    SELECT ca.Claim_Identifier, SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS loss
    FROM Claim_Amount ca
    WHERE ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier IN (
        SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM Loss_Payment
        UNION
        SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM Loss_Reserve
        UNION
        SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM Expense_Payment
        UNION
        SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM Expense_Reserve
    )
    GROUP BY ca.Claim_Identifier
)
SELECT p.Policy_Number,
       COUNT(DISTINCT cp.Claim_Identifier) AS number_of_claims,
       AVG(cl.loss) AS average_loss
FROM Policy p
JOIN claim_policy cp ON cp.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
JOIN claim_loss cl ON cl.Claim_Identifier = cp.Claim_Identifier
GROUP BY p.Policy_Identifier, p.Policy_Number

SELECT p.Policy_Number,
       AVG(julianday(c.Claim_Close_Date) - julianday(c.Claim_Open_Date)) AS avg_days_to_settle
FROM Claim c
JOIN Claim_Coverage cc ON cc.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail pcd ON pcd.Effective_Date = cc.Effective_Date
                               AND pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
JOIN Policy p ON p.Policy_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Identifier
WHERE c.Claim_Open_Date IS NOT NULL
  AND c.Claim_Close_Date IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY p.Policy_Number

SELECT DISTINCT
    apr.Party_Identifier AS Policy_Holder_Identifier,
    c.Claim_Identifier,
    c.Company_Claim_Number,
    cat.Catastrophe_Identifier,
    cat.Catastrophe_Name
FROM Agreement_Party_Role apr
JOIN Policy p
    ON p.Policy_Identifier = apr.Agreement_Identifier
JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail pcd
    ON pcd.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
JOIN Claim_Coverage cc
    ON cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
   AND cc.Effective_Date = pcd.Effective_Date
JOIN Claim c
    ON c.Claim_Identifier = cc.Claim_Identifier
JOIN Catastrophe cat
    ON cat.Catastrophe_Identifier = c.Catastrophe_Identifier
WHERE apr.Party_Role_Code = 'PH'

SELECT c.Company_Claim_Number, ca.Claim_Amount AS Loss_Reserve_Amount
FROM Claim c
JOIN Claim_Amount ca ON ca.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
JOIN Loss_Reserve lr ON lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
ORDER BY c.Company_Claim_Number

SELECT p.Policy_Identifier AS policy_id,
       apr.Party_Identifier AS policy_holder_id
FROM Policy p
JOIN Agreement_Party_Role apr
  ON apr.Agreement_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
WHERE apr.Party_Role_Code = 'PH'

SELECT ag.Party_Identifier AS Agent_Id,
       p.Policy_Number,
       c.Company_Claim_Number AS Claim_Number,
       SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS Expense_Reserve_Amount
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT Agreement_Identifier, Party_Identifier
      FROM Agreement_Party_Role
      WHERE Party_Role_Code = 'AG') ag
JOIN Policy p ON p.Policy_Identifier = ag.Agreement_Identifier
JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT cc.Claim_Identifier, pcd.Policy_Identifier
      FROM Claim_Coverage cc
      JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail pcd
        ON pcd.Effective_Date = cc.Effective_Date
       AND pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier) cp
  ON cp.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
JOIN Claim c ON c.Claim_Identifier = cp.Claim_Identifier
JOIN Claim_Amount ca ON ca.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
JOIN Expense_Reserve er ON er.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
GROUP BY ag.Party_Identifier, p.Policy_Number, c.Company_Claim_Number
ORDER BY ag.Party_Identifier, p.Policy_Number, c.Company_Claim_Number

SELECT apr.Party_Identifier AS agent_id,
       COUNT(DISTINCT p.Policy_Identifier) AS policy_count
FROM Agreement_Party_Role apr
JOIN Policy p ON apr.Agreement_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
WHERE apr.Party_Role_Code = 'AG'
GROUP BY apr.Party_Identifier
ORDER BY policy_count DESC

SELECT apr.Party_Identifier AS Agent_Id,
       p.Policy_Number,
       c.Company_Claim_Number AS Claim_Number,
       SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS Loss_Reserve_Amount
FROM Agreement_Party_Role apr
JOIN Policy p
  ON apr.Agreement_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
JOIN (
  SELECT DISTINCT cc.Claim_Identifier, pcd.Policy_Identifier
  FROM Claim_Coverage cc
  JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail pcd
    ON cc.Effective_Date = pcd.Effective_Date
   AND cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
) cp
  ON cp.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
JOIN Claim c
  ON c.Claim_Identifier = cp.Claim_Identifier
JOIN Claim_Amount ca
  ON ca.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
JOIN Loss_Reserve lr
  ON lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
WHERE apr.Party_Role_Code = 'AG'
GROUP BY apr.Party_Identifier, p.Policy_Number, c.Company_Claim_Number
ORDER BY apr.Party_Identifier, p.Policy_Number, c.Company_Claim_Number

SELECT Company_Claim_Number
FROM Claim
WHERE Claim_Close_Date >= '2019-01-01'
  AND Claim_Close_Date < '2020-01-01'

WITH claim_total AS (
    SELECT ca.Claim_Identifier,
           SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS Total_Loss
    FROM Claim_Amount ca
    WHERE ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier IN (
        SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM Loss_Payment
        UNION
        SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM Loss_Reserve
        UNION
        SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM Expense_Payment
        UNION
        SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM Expense_Reserve
    )
    GROUP BY ca.Claim_Identifier
),
claim_policy AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT cc.Claim_Identifier, pcd.Policy_Identifier
    FROM Claim_Coverage cc
    JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail pcd
      ON cc.Effective_Date = pcd.Effective_Date
     AND cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
)
SELECT c.Company_Claim_Number,

LEFT JOIN Catastrophe cat ON cat.Catastrophe_Identifier = c.Catastrophe_Identifier
LEFT JOIN claim_policy cp ON cp.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Policy p ON p.Policy_Identifier = cp.Policy_Identifier
ORDER BY c.Company_Claim_Number, p.Policy_Number

SELECT apr.Party_Identifier AS Policy_Holder_Identifier,
       p.Policy_Identifier,
       p.Policy_Number,
       pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier,
       pa.Policy_Amount AS Premium_Amount,
       pa.Amount_Type_Code,
       pa.Earning_Begin_Date,
       pa.Earning_End_Date
FROM Premium pr
JOIN Policy_Amount pa ON pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier
JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail pcd ON pcd.Effective_Date = pa.Effective_Date
                               AND pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = pa.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
JOIN Policy p ON p.Policy_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Identifier
JOIN Agreement_Party_Role apr ON apr.Agreement_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
                             AND apr.Party_Role_Code = 'PH'
ORDER BY apr.Party_Identifier, p.Policy_Identifier, pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier

SELECT SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT pa.Policy_Identifier) AS average_policy_size
FROM Premium p
JOIN Policy_Amount pa ON pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier = p.Policy_Amount_Identifier

SELECT p.Policy_Number,
       pcd.Effective_Date AS Coverage_Effective_Date,
       pcd.Expiration_Date AS Coverage_Expiration_Date,
       pa.Policy_Amount AS Premium_Amount
FROM Premium pr
JOIN Policy_Amount pa ON pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier
JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail pcd ON pa.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
                               AND pa.Effective_Date = pcd.Effective_Date
JOIN Policy p ON pcd.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier

SELECT c.Company_Claim_Number,
       SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS total_loss
FROM Claim c
JOIN Claim_Amount ca ON ca.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
WHERE ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier IN (
    SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM Loss_Payment
    UNION
    SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM Loss_Reserve
    UNION
    SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM Expense_Payment
    UNION
    SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM Expense_Reserve
)
GROUP BY c.Company_Claim_Number

WITH agent_policy AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT apr.Party_Identifier AS agent_id, p.Policy_Identifier
    FROM Agreement_Party_Role apr
    JOIN Policy p ON apr.Agreement_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
    WHERE apr.Party_Role_Code = 'AG'
),
policy_claim AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT pcd.Policy_Identifier, cc.Claim_Identifier
    FROM Claim_Coverage cc
    JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail pcd
      ON cc.Effective_Date = pcd.Effective_Date
     AND cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
),
loss_amount AS (
    SELECT ca.Claim_Identifier, ca.Claim_Amount
    FROM Claim_Amount ca
    WHERE ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier IN (
        SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM Loss_Payment
        UNION ALL
        SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM Loss_Reserve
        UNION ALL
        SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM Expense_Payment
        UNION ALL
        SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM Expense_Reserve
    )
)
SELECT ap.agent_id,
       ap.Policy_Identifier,
       SUM(la.Claim_Amount) AS total_loss
FROM agent_policy ap
JOIN policy_claim pc ON pc.Policy_Identifier = ap.Policy_Identifier
JOIN loss_amount la ON la.Claim_Identifier = pc.Claim_Identifier
GROUP BY ap.agent_id, ap.Policy_Identifier
ORDER BY ap.agent_id, ap.Policy_Identifier

WITH prem AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(pa.Policy_Identifier, pcd.Policy_Identifier) AS Policy_Identifier,
           SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS total_premium
    FROM Policy_Amount pa
    JOIN Premium pr ON pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail pcd
           ON pcd.Effective_Date = pa.Effective_Date
          AND pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = pa.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
    GROUP BY COALESCE(pa.Policy_Identifier, pcd.Policy_Identifier)
),
claim_policy AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT cc.Claim_Identifier, pcd.Policy_Identifier
    FROM Claim_Coverage cc
    JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail pcd
      ON pcd.Effective_Date = cc.Effective_Date
     AND pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
),
loss AS (
    SELECT cp.Policy_Identifier,
           SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS total_loss
    FROM Claim_Amount ca
    JOIN Loss_Payment lp ON lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    JOIN claim_policy cp ON cp.Claim_Identifier = ca.Claim_Identifier
    GROUP BY cp.Policy_Identifier
),
agent AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT Agreement_Identifier AS Policy_Identifier, Party_Identifier AS Agent_Id
    FROM Agreement_Party_Role
    WHERE Party_Role_Code = 'AG'
)
SELECT p.Policy_Number,
       a.Agent_Id,
       COALESCE(l.total_loss, 0) AS total_loss,
       pr.total_premium,
       CASE WHEN pr.total_premium IS NULL OR pr.total_premium = 0 THEN NULL
            ELSE COALESCE(l.total_loss, 0) * 1.0 / pr.total_premium END AS loss_ratio
FROM Policy p
JOIN agent a ON a.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN prem pr ON pr.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN loss l ON l.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
ORDER BY p.Policy_Number, a.Agent_Id

SELECT DISTINCT p.Policy_Number, c.Company_Claim_Number
FROM Claim c
JOIN Claim_Coverage cc ON cc.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail pcd ON pcd.Effective_Date = cc.Effective_Date
    AND pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
JOIN Policy p ON p.Policy_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Identifier
ORDER BY p.Policy_Number, c.Company_Claim_Number

SELECT p.Policy_Number, apr.Party_Identifier AS Agent_Id
FROM Policy p
JOIN Agreement_Party_Role apr ON apr.Agreement_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
WHERE apr.Party_Role_Code = 'AG'

SELECT c.Company_Claim_Number, ca.Claim_Amount AS Expense_Payment_Amount
FROM Claim c
JOIN Claim_Amount ca ON ca.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
JOIN Expense_Payment ep ON ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
ORDER BY c.Company_Claim_Number

WITH claim_policy AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT pcd.Policy_Identifier, cc.Claim_Identifier
    FROM Claim_Coverage cc
    JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail pcd
      ON cc.Effective_Date = pcd.Effective_Date
     AND cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
),
claim_loss AS (
    SELECT ca.Claim_Identifier, SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS total_loss
    FROM Claim_Amount ca
    WHERE ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier IN (
        SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM Loss_Payment
        UNION
        SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM Loss_Reserve
        UNION
        SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM Expense_Payment
        UNION
        SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM Expense_Reserve
    )
    GROUP BY ca.Claim_Identifier
),
policy_loss AS (
    SELECT cp.Policy_Identifier,
           COUNT(DISTINCT cp.Claim_Identifier) AS number_of_claims,
           SUM(COALESCE(cl.total_loss, 0)) AS total_loss
    FROM claim_policy cp
    LEFT JOIN claim_loss cl ON cl.Claim_Identifier = cp.Claim_Identifier
    GROUP BY cp.Policy_Identifier
),
policy_premium AS (
    SELECT pa.Policy_Identifier, SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS premium
    FROM Policy_Amount pa
    JOIN Premium pr ON pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier

claim_policy AS (

SELECT c.Company_Claim_Number AS claim_number,

SELECT c.Company_Claim_Number AS claim_number,

       CASE WHEN pr.premium_total IS NOT NULL AND pr.premium_total <> 0
            THEN COALESCE(l.loss_total, 0) * 1.0 / pr.premium_total
       END AS loss_ratio
FROM Policy p
JOIN agents a ON a.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier

LEFT JOIN (SELECT ca.Claim_Identifier, SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS total

LEFT JOIN (SELECT ca.Claim_Identifier, SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS total

           GROUP BY ca.Claim_Identifier) lr

LEFT JOIN (SELECT ca.Claim_Identifier, SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS total

     AND pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier

policy_premium AS (

    JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail pcd

policy_holder AS (

),
policy_agent AS (
    SELECT Agreement_Identifier AS Policy_Identifier,

policy_claim AS (

)
SELECT pc.Policy_Number,

LEFT JOIN claim_loss cl ON cl.Claim_Identifier = pc.Claim_Identifier

SELECT c.Company_Claim_Number AS claim_number,

    )

WITH agent_policy AS (

),
policy_claim AS (

    ON pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier

WITH policy_claims AS (

      ON pcd.Effective_Date = cc.Effective_Date
     AND pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
),
loss AS (

    JOIN Loss_Payment lp ON lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    GROUP BY pc.Policy_Identifier
),
prem AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(pa.Policy_Identifier, pcd.Policy_Identifier) AS Policy_Identifier,
           SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS premium_total
    FROM Policy_Amount pa

    LEFT JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail pcd
      ON pcd.Effective_Date = pa.Effective_Date
     AND pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = pa.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
    GROUP BY COALESCE(pa.Policy_Identifier, pcd.Policy_Identifier)
),
agents AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT Agreement_Identifier AS Policy_Identifier, Party_Identifier AS Agent_Id
    FROM Agreement_Party_Role
    WHERE Party_Role_Code = 'AG'
)
SELECT p.Policy_Number,
       a.Agent_Id,
       COALESCE(l.loss_payment_total, 0) AS loss_payment_total,
       pr.premium_total,
       COALESCE(l.loss_payment_total, 0) * 1.0 / NULLIF(pr.premium_total, 0) AS loss_ratio
FROM Policy p
JOIN agents a ON a.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN loss l ON l.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN prem pr ON pr.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
ORDER BY p.Policy_Number, a.Agent_Id

SELECT DISTINCT p.Policy_Number, c.Company_Claim_Number
FROM Claim c
JOIN Claim_Coverage cc ON cc.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail pcd ON pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
 AND pcd.Effective_Date = cc.Effective_Date
JOIN Policy p ON p.Policy_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Identifier
ORDER BY p.Policy_Number, c.Company_Claim_Number

SELECT DISTINCT p.Policy_Number, apr.Party_Identifier AS Agent_Id
FROM Policy p
JOIN Agreement_Party_Role apr ON apr.Agreement_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
WHERE apr.Party_Role_Code = 'AG'

WITH amt AS (
  SELECT ca.Claim_Identifier,
         SUM(CASE WHEN lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount END) AS loss_payment,
         SUM(CASE WHEN lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount END) AS loss_reserve,
         SUM(CASE WHEN ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount END) AS expense_payment,
         SUM(CASE WHEN er.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount END) AS expense_reserve
  FROM Claim_Amount ca
  LEFT JOIN Loss_Payment lp ON lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
  LEFT JOIN Loss_Reserve lr ON lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
  LEFT JOIN Expense_Payment ep ON ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
  LEFT JOIN Expense_Reserve er ON er.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
  GROUP BY ca.Claim_Identifier
),
cp AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT cc.Claim_Identifier, pcd.Policy_Identifier,
         pcd.Effective_Date, pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
  FROM Claim_Coverage cc
  JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail pcd
    ON pcd.Effective_Date = cc.Effective_Date
   AND pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
),
prem AS (
  SELECT pa.Effective_Date, pa.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier,
         SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS premium_amount
  FROM Policy_Amount pa
  JOIN Premium pr ON pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier
  GROUP BY pa.Effective_Date, pa.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
)
SELECT c.Company_Claim_Number AS claim_number,
       p.Policy_Number AS policy_number,
       (SELECT group_concat(DISTINCT apr.Party_Identifier)
          FROM Agreement_Party_Role apr
         WHERE apr.Agreement_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
           AND apr.Party_Role_Code = 'PH') AS policy_holder,
       SUM(prem.premium_amount) AS premium_amount,
       cat.Catastrophe_Name AS catastrophe,
       (SELECT group_concat(DISTINCT apr.Party_Identifier)
          FROM Agreement_Party_Role apr
         WHERE apr.Agreement_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
           AND apr.Party_Role_Code = 'AG') AS agent,
       amt.loss_payment,
       amt.loss_reserve,
       amt.expense_payment,
       amt.expense_reserve
FROM Claim c
LEFT JOIN amt ON amt.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN cp ON cp.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Policy p ON p.Policy_Identifier = cp.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN prem
  ON prem.Effective_Date = cp.Effective_Date
 AND prem.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = cp.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Catastrophe cat ON cat.Catastrophe_Identifier = c.Catastrophe_Identifier
GROUP BY c.Claim_Identifier, p.Policy_Identifier

SELECT c.Company_Claim_Number AS claim_number,
       SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS expense_payment_amount
FROM Claim c
JOIN Claim_Amount ca ON ca.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
JOIN Expense_Payment ep ON ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
GROUP BY c.Claim_Identifier, c.Company_Claim_Number

SELECT p.Policy_Number,

JOIN Policy p ON p.Policy_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Identifier
GROUP BY p.Policy_Number

WITH policy_claim AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT pcd.Policy_Identifier, cc.Claim_Identifier
    FROM Claim_Coverage cc
    JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail pcd
      ON pcd.Effective_Date = cc.Effective_Date
     AND pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
),
claim_loss AS (

    FROM Claim_Amount ca
    WHERE ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier IN (
        SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM Loss_Payment
        UNION ALL SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM Loss_Reserve
        UNION ALL SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM Expense_Payment
        UNION ALL SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM Expense_Reserve
    )
    GROUP BY ca.Claim_Identifier
),
policy_loss AS (
    SELECT pc.Policy_Identifier,

           SUM(COALESCE(cl.total_loss, 0)) AS total_loss
    FROM policy_claim pc
    LEFT JOIN claim_loss cl ON cl.Claim_Identifier = pc.Claim_Identifier
    GROUP BY pc.Policy_Identifier
),
policy_premium AS (
    SELECT pcd.Policy_Identifier, SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS premium
    FROM Policy_Amount pa
    JOIN Premium pr ON pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier
    JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail pcd
      ON pcd.Effective_Date = pa.Effective_Date
     AND pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = pa.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
    GROUP BY pcd.Policy_Identifier
)
SELECT p.Policy_Number,
       pp.premium AS premium,
       pl.number_of_claims,
       pl.total_loss,
       pl.total_loss * 1.0 / NULLIF(pp.premium, 0) AS loss_ratio
FROM Policy p
JOIN policy_loss pl ON pl.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN policy_premium pp ON pp.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
ORDER BY p.Policy_Number

SELECT c.Company_Claim_Number, SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS expense_reserve_amount
FROM Claim c
JOIN Claim_Amount ca ON ca.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
JOIN Expense_Reserve er ON er.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
GROUP BY c.Claim_Identifier, c.Company_Claim_Number

SELECT p.Policy_Number,
       AVG(x.Claim_Amount) AS avg_loss
FROM Policy p
JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT pcd.Policy_Identifier,
           ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier,
           ca.Claim_Amount
    FROM Claim_Amount ca
    JOIN Claim_Coverage cc
      ON cc.Claim_Identifier = ca.Claim_Identifier
    JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail pcd
      ON pcd.Effective_Date = cc.Effective_Date
     AND pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
    WHERE ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier IN (
        SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM Loss_Payment
        UNION
        SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM Loss_Reserve
        UNION
        SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM Expense_Payment
        UNION
        SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM Expense_Reserve
    )
) x ON x.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
GROUP BY p.Policy_Number
SELECT COUNT(*) AS claim_count FROM Claim

SELECT Company_Claim_Number AS claim_number,
       Claim_Open_Date AS open_date,
       Claim_Close_Date AS close_date
FROM Claim

SELECT c.Company_Claim_Number AS claim_number,
       SUM(CASE WHEN lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) AS loss_payment_amount,
       SUM(CASE WHEN lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) AS loss_reserve_amount,
       SUM(CASE WHEN ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) AS expense_payment_amount,
       SUM(CASE WHEN er.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) AS expense_reserve_amount
FROM Claim c
JOIN Claim_Amount ca ON ca.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Loss_Payment lp ON lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Loss_Reserve lr ON lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Expense_Payment ep ON ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Expense_Reserve er ON er.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
GROUP BY c.Company_Claim_Number

WITH claim_policy AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT cc.Claim_Identifier, pcd.Policy_Identifier
    FROM Claim_Coverage cc
    JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail pcd
      ON pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
),
claim_amt AS (
    SELECT ca.Claim_Identifier,
           SUM(CASE WHEN lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount END) AS loss_payment,
           SUM(CASE WHEN lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount END) AS loss_reserve,
           SUM(CASE WHEN ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount END) AS expense_payment,
           SUM(CASE WHEN er.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount END) AS expense_reserve
    FROM Claim_Amount ca
    LEFT JOIN Loss_Payment lp ON lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN Loss_Reserve lr ON lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN Expense_Payment ep ON ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN Expense_Reserve er ON er.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    GROUP BY ca.Claim_Identifier
),
holder AS (
    SELECT Agreement_Identifier, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT Party_Identifier) AS policy_holder
    FROM Agreement_Party_Role
    WHERE Party_Role_Code = 'PH'
    GROUP BY Agreement_Identifier
),
premium AS (
    SELECT pcd.Policy_Identifier, SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS premium_amount
    FROM Policy_Amount pa
    JOIN Premium pr ON pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier
    JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier, Policy_Identifier
          FROM Policy_Coverage_Detail) pcd
      ON pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = pa.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
    GROUP BY pcd.Policy_Identifier
)
SELECT c.Company_Claim_Number AS claim_number,
       p.Policy_Number AS policy_number,
       h.policy_holder,
       pm.premium_amount,
       a.loss_payment,
       a.loss_reserve,
       a.expense_payment,
       a.expense_reserve
FROM Claim c
LEFT JOIN claim_policy cp ON cp.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Policy p ON p.Policy_Identifier = cp.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN holder h ON h.Agreement_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN premium pm ON pm.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN claim_amt a ON a.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
ORDER BY c.Company_Claim_Number, p.Policy_Number

SELECT h.Party_Identifier,
       SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS total_premium
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT apr.Party_Identifier, p.Policy_Identifier
    FROM Agreement_Party_Role apr
    JOIN Policy p ON apr.Agreement_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
    WHERE apr.Party_Role_Code = 'PH'
) h
JOIN (
    SELECT pa0.Policy_Amount_Identifier,
           pa0.Policy_Amount,
           COALESCE(pa0.Policy_Identifier, pcd.Policy_Identifier) AS Policy_Identifier
    FROM Policy_Amount pa0
    JOIN Premium pr ON pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa0.Policy_Amount_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail pcd
           ON pcd.Effective_Date = pa0.Effective_Date
          AND pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = pa0.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
) pa ON pa.Policy_Identifier = h.Policy_Identifier
GROUP BY h.Party_Identifier

SELECT c.Company_Claim_Number AS claim_number,
       SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS total_loss_amount
FROM Claim c
JOIN Claim_Amount ca ON ca.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
WHERE ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier IN (SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM Loss_Payment)
   OR ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier IN (SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM Loss_Reserve)
GROUP BY c.Company_Claim_Number

WITH claim_policy AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT cc.Claim_Identifier, pcd.Policy_Identifier
    FROM Claim_Coverage cc
    JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail pcd
      ON pcd.Effective_Date = cc.Effective_Date
     AND pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
),
agent_policy AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT Agreement_Identifier, Party_Identifier
    FROM Agreement_Party_Role
    WHERE Party_Role_Code = 'AG'
),
expense_total AS (
    SELECT ca.Claim_Identifier, SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS expense_payment_amount
    FROM Claim_Amount ca
    JOIN Expense_Payment ep ON ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    GROUP BY ca.Claim_Identifier
)
SELECT ap.Party_Identifier AS agent_id,
       p.Policy_Number,
       c.Company_Claim_Number AS claim_number,
       et.expense_payment_amount
FROM claim_policy cp
JOIN Claim c ON c.Claim_Identifier = cp.Claim_Identifier
JOIN Policy p ON p.Policy_Identifier = cp.Policy_Identifier
JOIN agent_policy ap ON ap.Agreement_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
JOIN expense_total et ON et.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
ORDER BY ap.Party_Identifier, p.Policy_Number, c.Company_Claim_Number

SELECT Policy_Number, Effective_Date, Expiration_Date
FROM Policy

SELECT p.Policy_Number,
       SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS total_premium
FROM Policy_Amount pa
JOIN Premium pr ON pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier
JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail pcd ON pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = pa.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
                               AND pcd.Effective_Date = pa.Effective_Date
JOIN Policy p ON p.Policy_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Identifier
GROUP BY p.Policy_Number
ORDER BY p.Policy_Number

SELECT apr.Party_Identifier AS policy_holder_id,

FROM Agreement_Party_Role apr
JOIN Policy p ON apr.Agreement_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
WHERE apr.Party_Role_Code = 'PH'
GROUP BY apr.Party_Identifier
SELECT COUNT(*) AS policy_count FROM Policy

SELECT p.Policy_Number,

FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT cc.Claim_Identifier, pcd.Policy_Identifier
    FROM Claim_Coverage cc
    JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail pcd
      ON pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
     AND pcd.Effective_Date = cc.Effective_Date
) cp
JOIN Policy p ON p.Policy_Identifier = cp.Policy_Identifier
JOIN Claim_Amount ca ON ca.Claim_Identifier = cp.Claim_Identifier
WHERE ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier IN (
    SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM Loss_Payment
    UNION
    SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM Loss_Reserve
    UNION
    SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM Expense_Payment
    UNION
    SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM Expense_Reserve
)
GROUP BY p.Policy_Number

SELECT apr.Party_Identifier AS agent_id,
       p.Policy_Number AS policy_number,
       c.Company_Claim_Number AS claim_number,
       SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS loss_payment_amount
FROM Agreement_Party_Role apr
JOIN Policy p ON p.Policy_Identifier = apr.Agreement_Identifier
JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail pcd ON pcd.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
JOIN Claim_Coverage cc ON cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
                      AND cc.Effective_Date = pcd.Effective_Date
JOIN Claim c ON c.Claim_Identifier = cc.Claim_Identifier
JOIN Claim_Amount ca ON ca.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
JOIN Loss_Payment lp ON lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
WHERE apr.Party_Role_Code = 'AG'
GROUP BY apr.Party_Identifier, p.Policy_Number, c.Company_Claim_Number

SELECT
  c.Company_Claim_Number AS claim_number,
  p.Policy_Number AS policy_number,
  ph.policy_holders AS policy_holder,
  prem.premium_amount AS premium_amount,
  ag.agents AS agent,
  amt.loss_payment AS loss_payment,
  amt.loss_reserve AS loss_reserve,
  amt.expense_payment AS expense_payment,
  amt.expense_reserve AS expense_reserve
FROM Claim c
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT ca.Claim_Identifier,
    SUM(CASE WHEN lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount END) AS loss_payment,
    SUM(CASE WHEN lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount END) AS loss_reserve,
    SUM(CASE WHEN ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount END) AS expense_payment,
    SUM(CASE WHEN er.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount END) AS expense_reserve
  FROM Claim_Amount ca
  LEFT JOIN Loss_Payment lp ON lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
  LEFT JOIN Loss_Reserve lr ON lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
  LEFT JOIN Expense_Payment ep ON ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
  LEFT JOIN Expense_Reserve er ON er.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
  GROUP BY ca.Claim_Identifier
) amt ON amt.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT DISTINCT cc.Claim_Identifier, pcd.Policy_Identifier
  FROM Claim_Coverage cc
  JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail pcd
    ON pcd.Effective_Date = cc.Effective_Date
   AND pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
) cp ON cp.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Policy p ON p.Policy_Identifier = cp.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT pcd.Policy_Identifier, SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS premium_amount
  FROM Policy_Amount pa
  JOIN Premium pr ON pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier
  JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail pcd
    ON pcd.Effective_Date = pa.Effective_Date
   AND pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = pa.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
  GROUP BY pcd.Policy_Identifier
) prem ON prem.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT Agreement_Identifier, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT Party_Identifier) AS policy_holders
  FROM Agreement_Party_Role
  WHERE Party_Role_Code = 'PH'
  GROUP BY Agreement_Identifier
) ph ON ph.Agreement_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT Agreement_Identifier, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT Party_Identifier) AS agents
  FROM Agreement_Party_Role
  WHERE Party_Role_Code = 'AG'
  GROUP BY Agreement_Identifier
) ag ON ag.Agreement_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
ORDER BY c.Company_Claim_Number, p.Policy_Number

SELECT DISTINCT apr.Party_Identifier AS Agent_Identifier,
       p.Policy_Identifier,
       p.Policy_Number,
       c.Claim_Identifier,
       cat.Catastrophe_Identifier,
       cat.Catastrophe_Name
FROM Agreement_Party_Role apr
JOIN Policy p ON apr.Agreement_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail pcd ON pcd.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
JOIN Claim_Coverage cc ON cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
                      AND cc.Effective_Date = pcd.Effective_Date
JOIN Claim c ON c.Claim_Identifier = cc.Claim_Identifier
JOIN Catastrophe cat ON cat.Catastrophe_Identifier = c.Catastrophe_Identifier
WHERE apr.Party_Role_Code = 'AG'

SELECT c.Company_Claim_Number AS claim_number,
       SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS loss_payment_amount
FROM Claim c
JOIN Claim_Amount ca ON ca.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
JOIN Loss_Payment lp ON lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
GROUP BY c.Claim_Identifier, c.Company_Claim_Number

SELECT p.Policy_Number,
       SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS premium_amount
FROM Policy_Amount pa
JOIN Premium pr ON pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier
JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail pcd ON pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = pa.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
JOIN Policy p ON p.Policy_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Identifier
GROUP BY p.Policy_Number
ORDER BY p.Policy_Number

WITH loss AS (
  SELECT ca.Claim_Identifier, SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS total_loss
  FROM Claim_Amount ca
  WHERE ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier IN (
    SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM Loss_Payment
    UNION
    SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM Loss_Reserve
    UNION
    SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM Expense_Payment
    UNION
    SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM Expense_Reserve
  )
  GROUP BY ca.Claim_Identifier
),
claim_policy AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT cc.Claim_Identifier, pcd.Policy_Identifier
  FROM Claim_Coverage cc
  JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail pcd
    ON pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier

),
prem AS (
  SELECT pcd.Policy_Identifier, SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS premium_amount

  JOIN Premium pr ON pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier
  JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail pcd
    ON pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = pa.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier

  GROUP BY pcd.Policy_Identifier
),
holder AS (
  SELECT Agreement_Identifier AS Policy_Identifier,
